description.text:
Polymorph Self
(Alteration)

Level: 4
Range: 0
Duration: 1 turn + 3 rounds/level
Casting Time: 4
Area of Effect: The caster
Saving Throw: None

With this spell the wizard can take the shape of six creatures. Each form, and the wizard's natural form, becomes a special ability for the duration: the wizard can change between them at any time and as often as <PRO_HESHE> wishes. In another form the wizard keeps <PRO_HISHER> mind and Hit Points but takes the body of the creature: its Strength, Dexterity, base Armor Class, attacks and natural protections; the bonus for a high Dexterity still counts. A higher Strength of the wizard's own does not carry over. Only as an ogre mage can the wizard cast spells or use items. When the spell ends, the wizard returns to <PRO_HISHER> natural form.

Hill Giant: Strength 19, Dexterity 10, Armor Class 3, 1 attack per round, 2d8 piercing as a +1 weapon; Barbarian Rage once each time this form is taken.
Ogre Mage: Strength 18/00, Dexterity 12, Armor Class 4, 1 attack per round, 1d10 slashing as a +1 weapon; can cast spells and use items.
Spider: Strength 15, Dexterity 17, base Armor Class 4, 2 attacks per round, 1d4+1 piercing as a +1 weapon with a poisonous bite; faster movement; Web Tangle once each time this form is taken.
Mustard Jelly: Strength 14, Dexterity 9, the wizard's own Armor Class, 1 attack per round at up to 15 feet, 5d4 crushing as a +3 weapon that slows and poisons; Magic Resistance 125% and strong resistances.
Hell Hound: Strength 18, Dexterity 15, base Armor Class 4, 1 attack per round, 1d10 piercing plus 1d6 fire as a +1 weapon; immune to fire; Fiery Breath every 3 rounds.
Rat: Strength 10, Dexterity 20, base Armor Class 4, 1 attack per round, 1d2 piercing as a +1 weapon; can Hide at any time.
